The tax is 0.00, and line 43 is a payment line, not a credit against the tax: Form 40 adds it into line 50 'Total Payments and Other Credits' and line 55 pays out line 50 above line 41 (PDF p.31; Line 43 under 'Payments and Other Credits', PDF p.13), so the projection's credit is refundable and is not limited to the tax: credits 155.00. State income tax = 0.00 - 155.00 = -155.00, paid out. On the return: line 20 0, no line 31 tax (gross income under the filing amount, 'NRF', PDF p.12), line 41 0, line 43 155, line 50 155, line 55 overpaid 155, the same as expected.
